rules.name: SLA Breach Penalty Deduction
rules.statement: The system must deduct financial penalties from the Store Partner's settlement amount when a verified SLA breach occurs.
rules.condition: when a third-party vendor fails to meet guaranteed uptime or response time thresholds defined in the SLA
exceptions: force majeure events explicitly defined in the SLA contract
breaches occurring during scheduled maintenance windows approved by the vendor
rules.if_violated: the system automatically reduces the payable settlement amount and logs the deduction reason in the immutable audit trail
rules.rationale: to financially incentivize vendors to maintain service quality and mitigate operational downtime

parameters.name: penalty_rate
parameters.description: percentage of transaction value or fixed fee deducted per minute of delay or downtime

parameters.name: threshold_duration
parameters.description: maximum allowed duration for delivery or response before a breach is triggered

rules.name: Agreement Version Locking
rules.statement: The system must prevent any modification to an active Store Partner Agreement version once a financial settlement has been finalized for that period.
rules.condition: when a Store Partner Agreement is in 'Active' status and a Financial Transaction Record has been generated for the current settlement cycle
exceptions: no exceptions; finalization triggers an immutable lock
rules.if_violated: the system rejects the change request and alerts the Platform Operator of a potential compliance violation
rules.rationale: to ensure settlement calculations remain accurate and legally defensible against retroactive changes

parameters.name: settlement_cycle_id
parameters.description: unique identifier for the specific financial period being settled

rules.name: Vendor Uptime Eligibility
rules.statement: A third-party vendor may only be eligible for revenue sharing if their historical uptime meets the minimum threshold defined in the active SLA.
rules.condition: when evaluating a vendor for inclusion in the active marketplace or for processing a new settlement batch
exceptions: vendors under probationary status with a temporary reduced threshold as defined in the contract
rules.if_violated: the system automatically suspends order allocation to the vendor until the next review cycle or manual reinstatement
rules.rationale: to prevent revenue loss and reputational damage caused by unreliable external dependencies

parameters.name: minimum_uptime_percentage
parameters.description: required percentage of operational time over the evaluation period

parameters.name: evaluation_window
parameters.description: timeframe over which uptime is measured (e.g., last 30 days)

rules.name: Dispute Escalation Trigger
rules.statement: The system must escalate a service degradation incident to the Platform Operator for manual review when a vendor breach exceeds the maximum allowable penalty cap.
rules.condition: when a calculated SLA penalty for a specific incident exceeds the maximum financial cap defined in the SLA
rules.if_violated: the system pauses automatic penalty deduction and flags the record for manual adjudication by the Platform Operator
rules.rationale: to allow human judgment in complex cases where automated penalties might be disproportionate or erroneous

parameters.name: max_penalty_cap
parameters.description: maximum financial amount that can be automatically deducted without manual review
